ctx.x: Was that the Corvello band with Tito Rodriquez singing? Or did that come --

No, no, no, no, no. Corvello hired first -- he hired -- had about two or three different guys. He had Paulo Flore, he had Polito Golindez, he had -- another kid I recommended, I forgot his name, I never seen him no more, and then after that, Corvello got hold of (unintelligible) and Bobby Scott. And that's when he got his best band.
And when you say you had a Jewish public, but was the Conga a club that attracted a kind of a carriage trade or --
